cleanup.result: The task-owned exact validator reinstall moved to Trash; no runtime dependency was added.

limits: This draft closes Phase 00 decisions; Phase 01 owns the final contract inventory and Go validators.

Ajv validates the closed JSON shape; the helper separately proves pre-parse profile limits, binding correlation, whole-value template limits, cross-budget invariants, and trusted relay descriptor matching.
The validator installation is temporary; the durable acquisition lock records the exact reinstall command, full package tree, registry integrity values, and package metadata hashes.

The trusted relay positive proves only the declarative local Ollama invocation tuple. It performs no model request and does not prove the server version, model digest, capabilities, or runtime behavior.

Runtime qualification must separately observe exact Ollama server 0.31.1 and granite4.1:3b digest 6fd349357287c7ffc9e38189a93b48ea175d24fc566b38f09cfc564fb7f303eb before and after POST /api/chat through the compiled GET /api/version and GET /api/tags inspection routes.
The deterministic example permits only APP_ENV=security-test and the closed generated-binding names; there is no generic child environment passthrough.
The schema accepts only the exact qualified Mastra SDK, base SDK, and Mastra Core descriptor; the prior LangGraph tuple is a negative fixture, not an MVP mode.

No project command, receiver URL, OpenBox credential value, output root, sandbox setting, raw-retention mode, arbitrary relay tuple, external provider credential, or non-loopback relay is expressible or authorized by the profile.
